content:
maya: heads-up — CI flake on structured-output eval for q4_0-quantized bring-up. eval-runner shows 12 failing funcalls but my local run is clean.
jonathan: hmm, any repro logs? stack trace? :eyes: 
maya: pasted CI excerpt below from build #4521 (sandbox) — looks like SchemaValidationError inside schema validator.
ci-bot: build 4521 | eval-runner | ERROR SchemaValidationError at sample 42 -> payload.args is string, expected object.
maya: log snippet: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "runner/eval_loop.py", line 214, in _validate_toolcall
    validate(instance=toolcall, schema=tool_schema)
  File "jsonschema/validators.py", line 123, in validate
jsonschema.exceptions.ValidationError: 'args' is not of type 'object'
```
priya: that screams "stringified args" — the quantized runtime sometimes emits nested JSON as a string when kernel perf path engages. saw this before in q8b experiments.
jonathan: can you paste the raw model output for that sample?
maya: sure — CI captured this produced_funccall field: ```json
{"name": "search", "args": "{\"query\": \"redwood inference\", \"k\": 5}"}```
jonathan: yep — args is a serialized string. validator expects args to be JSON object. our eval harness assumes the model returns parsed func call structures.
priya: two ways to handle: 1) make validator robust and auto-deserialize stringified JSON for args fields, 2) upstream: change postprocess that converts model streaming tokens into structured object (preferable but riskier for quick fix).
oleg: also noticed dashboards spiking for the new metric funcall_parity — frontend shows +10% failures on latest commit. looks correlated.
maya: repro locally with: `pytest tests/evals/test_struct_output.py::test_toolcall_roundtrip -k q4_0 -q` and also `python -m evals.runner --model local-q4_0 --cases=cases/structured_tool_call.json --log-level debug` — you can reproduce if you force quant path by setting ENV `EVAL_QUANT_MODE=1`.
jonathan: quick patch idea: in eval-runner pre-validate step, if isinstance(toolcall.get('args'), str): attempt json.loads and replace, but guard with try/except and record metric `funccall_arg_stringified` when conversion happens. that keeps CI stable and surfaces how often this occurs.
priya: agree. please also add an integration test that asserts the conversion and that schema validation passes afterwards. add a dashboard tile for `funccall_arg_stringified` so we can watch regressions.
oleg: I'll open PR with the small sanitizer + test + metrics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-evals/pull/2145 (draft)
maya: tagging @ci-bot for a rerun once PR lands. also, can we avoid treating this as a hard failure for now? maybe make runner emit a warning and mark sample as flaky unless parity regressions exceed threshold.
jonathan: fine as a temporary measure, but we should do upstream fix in token->struct parsing long term.
ci-bot: triggered rerun for build 4521 with extra logging flag --dump-raw-tokens (requested by maya).
priya: followups: 1) oleg opens PR (thanks), 2) add dashboard and alert for funcall_parity > 5% 3) add integration test for stringified args 4) create a small perf test to ensure auto-deserialize doesn't regress latency.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll update the onboarding checklist for q4_0 to include this check. :thumbsup:
oleg: on it, will update PR and ping here when ready. :bug:
